channel.title: NTS
channel.description: Updates for the NTS macOS app.

item.title: NTS 0.1.6
item.description:
- Crossfade is now on by default (toggle in the menu under Experimental)
- Pause then play returns to live radio; a quick pause (within ~15s) resumes instantly
- More reliable playback over long sessions and after sleep/standby
- Switching back to the just-played channel within ~10s no longer reloads
